nodes.description: Owner address stored in Owned contract; set to msg.sender in constructor and used by onlyOwner modifier checks.
Pending owner address used in the two-step ownership transfer (transferOwnership / acceptOwnership).
Public token symbol string set in the JORDAN constructor.
Public token name string set in the JORDAN constructor.
Public token decimals value set to 18 in the JORDAN constructor.
Total token supply; assigned in constructor and read by totalSupply().
Mapping of account address to token balance; mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to allowance; mutated by approve, approveAndCall and transferFrom.
SafeMath addition helper that computes c = a + b and requires c >= a to reject overflow.
SafeMath subtraction helper that requires b <= a before computing c = a - b.
SafeMath multiplication helper with an overflow guard (a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath division helper that requires b > 0 before computing c = a / b.
Owned constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner.
Function that lets the staged newOwner accept ownership and clears newOwner.
Initializes symbol, name, decimals, _totalSupply and pre-mints the entire supply to a fixed address.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)].
Returns the token balance of tokenOwner from the balances mapping.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to a recipient using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Spends allowance and moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd.
Returns remaining allowance for a spender over a token owner's balance.
Approves a spender and then invokes an arbitrary spender contract via receiveApproval, enabling reentrancy.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts to reject ETH.
onlyOwner function that performs an external ERC20 transfer call on an arbitrary token contract.
msg.sender is used for ownership assignment, onlyOwner checks, balance debits and allowance writes.
Integer addition c = a + b performed inside safeAdd; guarded only by a post-hoc require.
Integer subtraction c = a - b performed inside safeSub after a require(b <= a).
Integer multiplication c = a * b inside safeMul with a division-based overflow check.
Integer division c = a / b inside safeDiv guarded by require(b > 0).
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) that hands control to an untrusted contract.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on a caller-supplied token address.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner from msg.sender.
transferOwnership is gated by onlyOwner which compares msg.sender to owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before transferring ownership.
transferAnyERC20Token is protected by the onlyOwner modifier based on msg.sender.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom writes allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] and forwards msg.sender to the external call.
Constructor sets symbol = "JORDAN".
Constructor sets name = "JORDAN".
Constructor sets decimals = 18.
Constructor sets _totalSupply to the fixed supply.
Constructor pre-mints balances[holder] = _totalSupply.
transferOwnership writes the staged newOwner.
acceptOwnership promotes newOwner into owner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
totalSupply reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)].
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer updates sender and recipient balances.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
transferFrom updates balances of from and to.
transferFrom decreases the allowance in the allowed mapping.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external call.
transfer delegates the debit to safeSub.
transfer delegates the credit to safeAdd.
transferFrom uses safeSub for balance and allowance decreases.
transferFrom uses safeAdd for the recipient credit.
safeAdd performs the guarded integer addition c = a + b.
safeSub performs the guarded integer subtraction c = a - b.
safeMul performs the checked integer multiplication c = a * b.
safeDiv performs the checked integer division c = a / b.
approveAndCall invokes receiveApproval on an untrusted spender contract, handing over control.
The untrusted spender contract can re-enter JORDAN (e.g. transferFrom) before approveAndCall returns.
transferAnyERC20Token makes an external call to a caller-supplied token contract.
The external token contract could call back into the JORDAN contract during the transfer call.

Local c is the return value produced by safeSub.

Parameter b feeds safeMul.
Local c is the return value produced by safeMul.
Parameter a feeds safeDiv.
Parameter b feeds safeDiv.
Local c is the return value produced by safeDiv.

Parameter data is forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
Parameter tokenAddress is the external call target in transferAnyERC20Token.
Parameter tokens is the amount passed to the external ERC20 transfer.
